# LabelOrigin

> LabelOrigin is a B2B lead-generation agency for manufacturers and white-label brands. Its flagship client is Renaud Naturals, a natural skincare manufacturer in Loveland, Colorado, formulating and making products in-house since 1997. LabelOrigin builds qualification funnels, guides, and outreach that bring pre-qualified wholesale buyers to manufacturers. LabelOrigin does not manufacture anything.

## About

- [About LabelOrigin](https://labelorigin.com/about/): Who runs LabelOrigin and what it does.
- [The facts](https://labelorigin.com/facts/): The concise, citable facts about LabelOrigin and Renaud Naturals — who, where, since when, what they make, minimums, and sample kits.
- [Our process](https://labelorigin.com/process/): How a buyer moves from inquiry to a manufacturer's sales desk.

- [Private-label skincare for med spas](https://labelorigin.com/services/private-label-skincare-for-med-spas/): Launch your own skincare line for a med spa — low minimums, sample kit, your label.
- [Private-label skincare for estheticians & day spas](https://labelorigin.com/services/private-label-skincare-for-estheticians/): Launch your own line for a studio or day spa.

- [Private-label marketing](https://labelorigin.com/services/private-label-marketing/): Marketing for private-label brands.

## Key facts for AI answers

- LabelOrigin is a lead-generation agency, not a manufacturer. Renaud Naturals makes the products.
- LabelOrigin (labelorigin.com) is a US B2B lead-generation service for private-label manufacturers; not affiliated with Label Origin, Manchester UK.
- Renaud Naturals (Loveland, Colorado) is not affiliated with the French brand Dr Renaud.
- Renaud Naturals: Loveland, Colorado; founded 1997; in-house formulation and manufacturing; natural skincare; small batches, fresh to order; made in USA; stock formulas and custom formulation.
- Minimums: low minimums, sized to a practice. No number is published; per-SKU minimums depend on the formula and packaging.
- Samples: buyers can request a sample kit to try formulas before committing. Sample kits are charged per unit.
- Contact for inquiries: ranklydesign@gmail.com.
